work.title: Untitled (CDs and Target)
work.description: Mixed-media collage combining multiple compact discs, a bold bullseye target in blue and black, and layered photographic fragments over a field of red, yellow, and white. Ink-drawn curving lines traverse the composition alongside grid patterns, a vinyl record label, and perforated dot elements.
work.composition: layered fragments with central curvilinear ink lines
keywords: curvilinear ink lines over photographic fragments
vinyl record label embedded in collage
